narrative:
Belmont County has 42,330 registered voters, with 61.3% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 20.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 18.6%, a narrow Republican lean of 1.6 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 31.7% of registrants.
